items.text: Big Brother viewers speechless as they realise where they know Omar from
items.article: Big Brother housemate Omar El Mayer has surprised fans after it emerged the 21-year-old jewellery seller also has a hidden side career that fans are only just discovering Big Brother fans have realised that they recognise contestant Omar El Mayer from somewhere. While he entered the house as a jewellery trader, it has now emerged that the 21-year-old has another hidden career. He's actually an accomplished rapper and several fans have already clocked who he is. He goes by the stage moniker PAIID and has racked up nearly 30,000 monthly listeners on Spotify. One of his biggest hits is a track called Paid The Price and runs at just over two minutes, a track which has been played an impressive 301,927 times. Another tune titled Magalo has clocked up 231,820 streams. He is also an online content creator, though his social media profiles seem to have been deactivated while he's locked away in the Big Brother house. He was posting content under various usernames that featured his rap alias, reports OK! . Plenty of Big Brother fans have been discussing Omar's musical background and many are stunned by the discovery. One gobsmacked viewer remarked: "I knew I recognised him!". Another posted on Reddit: "Haven't seen anyone post this but Omar raps on the outside? The Instagram post has a couple clips and icl it's not my thing."

items.article: The plan envisages acceptance and enablement of digital payments across the education ecosystem, covering schools, students and parents. | Education News The Central Board of Secondary Education, CBSE has issued notice for promotion of digital payments in schools. The official notice can be checked on the official website of CBSE at cbse.gov.in. As per the official notice, the Department of Financial Services (DFS), Ministry of Finance has developed a comprehensive digital payments promotion plan, with the objective of expanding access, increasing usage, and promoting safe digital payment practices across the country. NWR Apprentice Recruitment 2026: Apply for 2008 posts at rrcjaipur.in, details here The plan envisages acceptance and enablement of digital payments across the education ecosystem, covering schools, students and parents. The Board has advised to take following measures for promotion of digital payment in schools: Universal Acceptance Infrastructure: School may enable digital payments including UPI and Ru-Pay card, across all payment touch-points such as fees, canteens, libraries and other services. School in low-connectivity areas may adopt UPI Lite, UPI LiteX, and UPI 123PAY. Demonstrations and assisted usage models may be promoted for ease adoption.
